name: Will I still need to pay closing costs if I accept a cash offer for my condo?

mainEntity.name: Will I still need to pay closing costs if I accept a cash offer for my condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, even with a cash offer, sellers typically still incur closing costs. These can include title insurance premiums, prorated property taxes and homeowners association dues, legal fees, and real estate commissions. While a cash offer eliminates lender-related fees for the buyer, it doesn't remove the standard costs associated with transferring property ownership. Understanding these potential expenses is crucial when evaluating a cash offer against other proposals. We can provide a detailed estimate of your seller closing costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sellers still pay closing costs with a cash offer, including title insurance, prorated taxes/HOA dues, legal fees, and commissions, as these are separate from buyer financing costs.
